opomba: Izdaje Wayfare Studia za stran Novosti (zgradi.py). Najnovejša na vrhu. Izdaja z "objavljeno": false je osnutek in je na strani ni; ob izdaji nastavi true in datum.

sl.uvod: Claude je zdaj v aplikaciji, tudi z naročnino Claude, 3D pot pa je dobila prave modele in tvoje slike.
spremembe: Plošča Claude v studiu: poveš, kaj želiš, Claude uredi montažo z orodji aplikacije, vsak korak vrneš s ⌘Z.
Claude dela z naročnino Claude (Pro ali Max) prek Claude Code na računalniku, brez ključa API, ali s ključem API.
Preprost način z jezikom brez žargona in enim gumbom za izvoz.
Prvi zagon brez trenja: na Macu svoje okno namesto zavihka v brskalniku, posnetke povlečeš vanj ali jih uvoziš naravnost s kartice.
Izrez s sledenjem, umiritev tresočih posnetkov in iskanje po vsebini posnetkov.
Objava naravnost na YouTube, TikTok in Instagram, potovanje po dnevih in spremljevalec na telefonu.
3D pot s pravimi modeli vozil, kipi krajev in potmi po cestah, tirih in med letališči; mirna kamera, sence, let v loku in noč.
3D pot s tvojimi slikami krajev in obrazi potnikov z imeni.
Pregled ne posvetli več noči in temnih prostorov, kadri si sledijo po krajevni uri.
Odziv iz aplikacije: v meniju ⋯ ali ob koncu izvoza poveš, kaj popraviti ali dodati.
Časovnica ob drsenju obdrži imena sledi, 3D pot ima zamegljeno steklo tudi v oknu na Macu.

en.uvod: Claude now lives inside the app, also with your Claude subscription, and the 3D route got real models and your own photos.
spremembe: Claude panel in the studio: say what you want, Claude edits with the app's own tools, and you undo any step with ⌘Z.
Claude works with your Claude subscription (Pro or Max) through Claude Code on your computer, no API key needed, or with an API key.
Simple mode with plain language and a single export button.
Frictionless first run: on the Mac its own window instead of a browser tab; drag clips into it or import them straight from a card.
Tracking crop, stabilisation for shaky clips and search by what's in your clips.
Publish straight to YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, trips organised by day, and a phone companion.
3D route with real vehicle models, landmark statues and routes along roads, rail and between airports; a calm camera, shadows, arcing flights and night.
3D route with your own place photos and travellers' faces with names.
Review no longer brightens night and dark interiors, and shots follow the local clock.
Feedback from the app: tell us what to fix or add from the ⋯ menu or when an export finishes.
The timeline keeps track names while you scroll, and the 3D route's frosted glass now works in the Mac window too.

sl.uvod: Prva javna različica. Dan pozneje sta v isto izdajo prišla še Windows in Android.
spremembe: Wayfare Studio za Mac z Apple silicon (macOS 12 ali novejši).
Različica za 64-bitni Windows 10 ali novejši z namestitvenim programom.
Različica za Android 8 ali novejši: studio z zavihki Montaža, Material in Lastnosti, predogled nad časovnico.
Na Androidu gre končan film naravnost v galerijo (Movies/Wayfare), deliš ga z gumbom Deli.

en.uvod: The first public release. A day later, Windows and Android joined the same release.
spremembe: Wayfare Studio for Macs with Apple silicon (macOS 12 or later).
A version for 64-bit Windows 10 or later, with an installer.
A version for Android 8 or later: the studio with Edit, Media and Properties tabs and the preview above the timeline.
On Android the finished film goes straight to the gallery (Movies/Wayfare) and you share it with the Share button.
